build_nowcasting_model: build a NowcastingModel with TimeSeriesData and NowcastingParams for short-term time series forecasting
run_feature_extraction: run feature extraction on the NowcastingModel to compute MOM, ROC, LAG, and MA features
fit_nowcasting_model: fit the NowcastingModel using RandomForestRegressor or LinearRegression on extracted features
predict_nowcasting: predict future values using the fitted NowcastingModel with step-ahead nowcasting
create_nowcasting_params: create NowcastingParams with a step value to configure how many steps ahead to forecast
